priceSnapshot.note: Spot 77,168.8. One data-integrity note first, because it changed what this report is built on. The FIRST /market/ticker pull of this run came back STALE - stamped 2026-09-12T07:51:45Z, roughly 23 hours old, carrying last 77,286.2 with a 24h band of 76,001.0 to 79,896.3 that actually belongs to the 11 September spike day. It was DISCARDED. A second pull taken from the browser context returned ts 2026-09-13T07:08:17.662Z against OKX server time 07:08:17.790Z, 128 milliseconds apart, with last 77,168.8 matching the live 07:05Z five-minute close exactly - that is the number used here. The minus 0.24 percent is ticker open24h of 77,350.6 against last, a genuine 181.8-point decline. Since the endday mark at 19:35 COT price has travelled a 281.0-point box, 77,063.1 to 77,344.1, which is 12.7 percent of a 2,208.43 daily ATR - the tightest overnight range of this entire compression sequence. The single number that matters: the session low of 77,063.1 printed on the 06:00Z hour, 19.9 points above the 1Dutc EMA20 at 77,043.2. Yesterday the same EMA was defended to within 0.2 points at 77,064.9. Two consecutive sessions have now bottomed within twenty points of the same rising daily average and turned.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 77,000.0, which is 168.8 points under spot. This gate is now on its SIXTH consecutive publication and has not fired once. The lowest settled hourly close since the endday mark is 77,120.1 on the 06:00Z bar and the lowest wick 77,063.1, so the wick came 63.1 points short and the close 120.1 points short. What the gate really guards is the 1Dutc EMA20 at 77,043.2: price has bottomed 19.9 points above it tonight and 0.2 points above it yesterday, so a settled close through 77,000.0 would be the first time in the sequence that the daily average failed rather than held, and it would do so with the account-level crowd sitting 1.67 long.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,528.3, the 4H EMA20, 359.5 points above spot. This is deliberately set above the 24h high of 77,507.1 rather than at it. Price has failed at the 77,500 shelf twice in two days - 77,507.1 on the 12 September 14:00Z bar and 77,500.0 on the 11 September 22:00Z bar - and the OKX tape shows 627,637 USD of short-side liquidations bucketed at 77,500, meaning that shelf has already spent its fuel. Reclaiming the 4H EMA20 on a settled close is the first evidence that would separate a genuine recovery from another squeeze into the same ceiling.

decisionBox.changed: Position moves from REDUCE to HOLD, and the reason is the daily EMA20 rather than any change in the directional read. Endday cut 10 percent of the spot core to raise cash ahead of the weekend gap; that gap has now passed without incident, price closed 100.0 points BELOW where the trim executed, and the core that remains sits above every daily exponential average - EMA20 77,043.2, EMA50 73,053.7, EMA100 70,962.6, EMA200 72,421.8. There is nothing left to reduce on the long-term book at a level that has held twice. The reduce gate stays at 77,000.0 unchanged for a sixth session; the add gate moves DOWN from 77,540.9 to 77,528.3 to sit exactly on the 4H EMA20 rather than an arbitrary point above the high. The resting-stop recommendation stays FALSE - the next report is roughly 06:50 COT, under five hours away, and a stop at 76,880.1 would have cleared tonight's low by 183.0 points without ever being needed.

liquidityMagnet.note: Called BALANCED because the two honest readings point opposite ways and neither deserves to be suppressed. MEASURED MASS says up: 629,339 USD of the 693,012 USD total sits above spot, 90.8 percent of it, and 627,637 USD of that in one bucket at 77,500. POSITIONING says down: the OKX long/short account ratio has printed 1.67, 1.67, 1.67, 1.68 on the last four hourly bars - a stable, crowded long book - and funding is positive at 0.0083 percent for the 08:00Z settlement, so longs are paying to stay long into a level that has already rejected twice. The reconciling detail is that the measured mass is REALIZED, not resting: those shorts were already liquidated on Saturday's failed push. What is left untested is the long side, and it sits above a floor with only 632 USD of cushion between spot and 77,000.0. Direction is genuinely unresolved; size is not. The OKX free feed was fresh and complete this run, so no CoinGlass browser fallback was needed.

calibration.note: Endday's discretionary calls both aged well and for once the reasoning, not just the outcome, was right. It trimmed 10 percent of the spot core at 77,268.8 to raise cash; spot marks 77,168.8, so the trim is 100.0 points and 0.13 percent ONSIDE. It held the futures short from 77,346.4; that is now 177.6 points onside, up from 77.6 at the endday mark. The one thing endday got wrong was the shape of the risk: it warned of an air pocket between 77,050 and 76,780 opening on a weekend break. The break never came - price bottomed 77,063.1, 13.1 points above the top of that hole - and the weekend gap it feared turned out to be the quietest 281-point box of the sequence.
